# 🎲 Number Guessing Game

![C++](https://img.shields.io/badge/Language-C++-blue.svg)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)

---

## 🎯 Project Overview
**Number Guessing Game** is a simple **C++ console-based game** where the player tries to guess a random number generated by the computer. The game includes multiple difficulty levels and tracks the number of correct and wrong guesses.

---

## 🚀 Features
- 🎯 Multiple difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Mix.
- 🧮 Random number generation for each round.
- ✅ Tracks correct and wrong guesses.
- 📊 Displays final result: Pass/Fail.
- 🎮 Simple console-based user interface, beginner-friendly.

---

## 🛠️ Technologies Used
| Technology     | Purpose |
|----------------|---------|
| **C++**        | Core game logic |
| **Console App**| User interaction via terminal |
| **Visual Studio** | Development and debugging |
